latestVersion.changelog:
DDGS Web Search Skill 1.0.0

- Initial release of the DDGS web search skill, enabling real-time, privacy-friendly search across text, news, images, videos, and books.
- Provides region, safesearch, and timelimit parameters for flexible querying.
- Supports MCP and API server integration.
- No API key required; no user tracking.
- Includes practical code examples for all search features, reusable functions, and error handling.
- Documentation covers region codes, search parameters, proxy usage, and troubleshooting tips.
